name: t5s_us20_500m
description: Phase 3 T5s section 4.2b -- THE ESCALATION section 4.2a NAMED AND DID NOT RUN: the U_s=20 m/s sweep member re-run at 500 m, so that the resolution confound on the E trend is MEASURED rather than bounded. Refining t5s_us15 alone moved E by 0.908 (raw) / 0.991 (block-mean, on the reference grid), both larger than the us15 -> us20 shear step of 0.773 at 1 km; a one-member refinement can only BOUND that confound, because a common offset and a member-specific collapse are indistinguishable from one point. Two members refined make the 15 -> 20 gap readable AT MATCHED RESOLUTION, which is the comparison the transition claim actually needs. THIS FILE IS t5s_us20.json WITH FOUR GRID KEYS CHANGED AND NOTHING ELSE: nx and ny 180 -> 360, dx and dy 999.0 -> 499.5, so 360 x 499.5 m = 179820 m = 180 x 999 m EXACTLY -- the same physical domain refined 2x on aligned cell edges, which is what makes the block reduction onto the 1 km grid exact. umove stays 13.3 (t5s_us20's value, 0.6625 x U_s) and the sounding block stays U_s=20; both are deliberately NOT the us15 values, and the generated input_sounding sha256 must equal t5s_us20's recorded 7538c7ae..., which is a gate, not a hope. nz, dz, timax, tapfrq, dtl, adapt_dt, imove, irandp, iinit, iorigin, icor, ptype and ihail are byte-for-byte t5s_us20.json's. dtl stays 6.0 for the reason section 4.2a gives: adapt_dt=1 recomputes dt from CFL at the first adaptation, so dtl is a seed the solver leaves behind, and halving it would move a second variable for no effect. np=8 as for t5s_us15_500m: one run, not a concurrent pair (charter, production run config). Scoring, its bar and its branches are pre-registered in docs/plan-science-hurdles-2026-09-02.md section 4.2b and sim/probes/README.md BEFORE the first frame is read; NOTHING in the classifier is re-tuned for this run.

provenance.sounding: EXTERNAL (isnd=7): input_sounding GENERATED by pipeline/gen_sounding.py from sim.sounding -- IDENTICAL to t5s_us20's, and the sha256 match (7538c7ae1cac7d4438b1e3300dd3d30862e6bccdd14dda628d4c4b51c091750c) is a gate
provenance.sweep_role: 500 m RE-RUN of the PREDICTED SUPERCELL member -- the SECOND refined member, which is what turns a bound on the resolution confound into a measurement of it
provenance.resolution_note: CAPE, CIN, bulk shear and BRN are properties of the sounding FILE, not of the grid. They are carried over unchanged on purpose: a resolution change cannot move them, and a re-derived number here would only invite the question of why it differed.
provenance.compare_against: t5s_us20 (180^2 @ 999 m, same sounding sha256, same everything else) for the refinement delta; t5s_us15_500m for the MATCHED-RESOLUTION 15 -> 20 gap, which is the reading this run exists for

sounding._note: WK82 reference thermodynamics: theta_0=300 K, theta_tr=343 K, T_tr=213 K, z_tr=12 km, qv_pbl=14 g/kg, p_sfc=1000 hPa (module defaults; declared explicitly for the record). BYTE-IDENTICAL to t5s_us20.json's block -- U_s=20, NOT 15.
